title: PRDNER aquifer band registry revision
description: One append-only revision of a south-coast observation well's condition bands, as published on the USGS hydro-conditions page and attributed there to PRDNER. A new row is written only when the bands materially change. Depths are feet below land surface, positive down.

supersedes.description: registry_id of the revision this one replaces; null for revision 1.

asset_id.description: Stable-id binding to the groundwater-well asset. Names never bind.

site_name_source.description: The well's title as printed on the source page. Corroboration only.

municipality.description: Snapshot of the bound asset's municipality at the time of this revision.

depth_convention.const: feet below land surface, positive down (the source page plots the same numbers negated)

bands.description: Shallow to deep, contiguous, from the land surface. shallow_ft <= depth < deep_ft.

authority_claim.const: Puerto Rico Department of Natural and Environmental Resources (PRDNER), as attributed by the USGS page; not independently verified

effective_date.description: Always null: the source publishes no adoption or effective date.

reference_url.description: The page's own 'Map and Info' link for the well. Recorded, never fetched by this producer.

ladder_discrepancies.description: Differences, within rounding, between the page's chart ranges and its label ladder. Informational; not part of material_digest.
